example_sentences_in_bangla: তার সাথে আশনাই জন্মেছে, যদিও সবাই বিরোধিতা করছে।
এই আশনাই তাকে ধ্বংসের দিকে নিয়ে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: She has developed an infatuation with him, even though everyone opposes it.
This illicit romance will lead her to ruin.
history: The idiom is derived from poetic expressions in Bengali literature, such as the line 'মন যত বলে আশা নাই, হৃদে তত জাগে আশনাই', which reflects themes of hopeless yet irresistible love in folk and romantic traditions.
note: Often appears in songs and poetry to denote forbidden emotional attachments.
